authorResult.scope: Exact source/inverse review and independent V8 data-model checks only. No PowerShell parsing, .NET/UIA/provider calls, filesystem IO or native execution.

harnessConsistencyCorrection.change: Only the modeled report() overflow fallback key changes from outputUtf8Bytes to outputByteLimit; project().limits.outputUtf8Bytes and final PowerShell source remain unchanged.

limits.retainedGeometrySnapshots: LTR plus latest; no snapshot history
limits.scope: Counts and depth bound traversal; the poll is a retry window and does not cancel synchronous UIA calls.
limits.consoleByteScope: Full envelope plus trailing Environment.NewLine, excluding runner-added timestamp prefixes.

semantics.owner: The original Window and handle are retained. Native IsWindow/GetWindowThreadProcessId and UIA PID/HWND/runtime ID agree before and after observations.
semantics.uniqueness: Complete RawViewWalker searches count every discovered node. Missing, ambiguous, duplicate-ID, foreign-process or truncated trees fail; no candidate is selected from an incomplete search.
semantics.navigation: The single NYC-Tron named ancestor is established from actual ancestry of the unique toggle, never from the largest same-name MenuItemsHost.
semantics.icon: An actual descendant with exact AutomationId Icon is required. Its existence is unproved until CI. No fallback to FlowDirection or guessed geometry exists.
semantics.retention: Original selected UIA providers remain bound during polling. The final uniqueness walk checks their identities without substituting newly obtained wrappers.
semantics.geometry: Every accepted rectangle is a finite, positive, non-offscreen physical UIA BoundingRectangle. Snapshots bracket bounds reads and verify ancestry and owner identity. Final mirroring requires unchanged owner/navigation/toggle bounds and unchanged icon size/Y, with LTR icon wholly left and RTL icon wholly right of the button midpoint.
semantics.pane: The existing physical-left predicate reads the same validated navigation/owner snapshot as the icon witness.
semantics.timeout: The 10-second/100-ms settings and native action order are retained. A failed poll is not obscured by an additional final discovery walk.
semantics.output: The existing result file retains typed bounded state. A separate secondary console projector allowlists every status/reason/role, caps runtime ID arrays, preserves null unknowns, selects only finite numbers and fixed fields, and caps the full UTF-8 message at 8 KiB. It reads no UIA provider and cannot change success or the original error.
semantics.consoleFailure: Formatting/write exceptions are swallowed only inside the secondary reporting helper; an over-limit projection emits a fixed output-limit envelope. Main native/UIA failures are never swallowed.
semantics.stability: stable means matching sequential identity and rectangle observations within the retained provider set. It is not an atomic snapshot, a render-completion witness or proof of an unchanged tree between reads.

preserved: The native action order and every shipping layout/source file
The composed borrowed-GET ownership correction and owned-SET cleanup
Physical-left, selection, capture, later drawer and high-contrast assertions
Existing finally restoration and error handling except the added typed rtlWitness result field
evidenceLimits: AutomationId is optional. The pinned x:Name Icon and Raw annotation do not prove that this running provider exposes an Icon peer.
Runtime IDs are treated only as opaque comparison values. The observations do not claim lifetime uniqueness outside the retained elements.
IsOffscreen=false and a bounding rectangle do not prove absence of occlusion or inspected pixels.
No host, security, workflow, ref, PR or CI mutation is included.

The original script has no separate rendered-title assertion. This change preserves the shipping title layout and the named navigation-ancestor check, without claiming inspected title pixels or a new title pass.
Stable sequential observations do not establish atomicity, render completion or continuous geometry between observations.
The source review does not establish Raw Icon peer availability or actual rendered mirroring.
No earlier runtime failure cause, host eligibility, elevated-host support or release acceptance is inferred.
Model checks execute JavaScript data models and inspect source; they do not execute PowerShell or emulate a real provider.
